artworks.label: Cherry claw cabinet
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE wholly original square 1024 x 1024 standalone small-widget illustration for Glaze cherry-arcade. An exquisite retro-futurist miniature arcade claw cabinet, glossy cherry-red rounded frame, clear pale-mint glass chamber containing a small pair of shiny sculptural cherries, tiny ivory three-pronged claw suspended inside, two unmarked round controls on a blush ledge, low blush plinth. Sophisticated toy-design architectural-model photography, glossy enamel and transparent mint resin, warm soft daylight, refined pale-blush/cherry-red/mint palette. No lettering or display, no numbers, no signage or score panel, no IP characters. Center the entire complete sculpture with generous 18 percent empty margins, strong silhouette, no clipped objects. True TRANSPARENT empty background, alpha preserved, no ground plane, tile, frame, wall, scene collage or contact sheet. Pure illustration only: no text, letters, numbers, dates, clocks, clock hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. New subject, never a crop/copy/recolour of existing artwork.
